disallowedConcepts: advanced grammar terminology before communicative use
globalRules: Keep every topic at A0-to-A1 difficulty.
Use official Kreyòl spelling and preserve meaningful diacritics.
Use integrated receptive and productive practice rather than quiz-only instruction.
Do not use programming runtime or code-workspace language.
Do not describe speech transcript matching as a pronunciation score.
Module 1 must have accessOverride free; later modules inherit paid access.

notes: Give true beginners enough sound and spelling confidence to approach their first spoken and written Kreyòl without treating English spelling as a guide.
Use the four topic shells in order: learn/notice, listen/speak, read/build/write, then use-it/review.
